name: Menethil's Gift
label: Quest
description: Menethil's Gift: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I watched as the human, Ras Frostwhisper, pledged his undying soul to the Lich King. He drew the dagger to his own throat and with a smile, cut from ear to ear. His body collapsed inside the borders of the pentagram. The Lich King stood over the fallen mage and with a single motion, Ras Frostwhisper the lich, was born.
Yes, traveler, I remember. What you seek has a name - Menethil's Gift: The ground blessed by the Lich King - holy ground to Scourge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The area around Menethil's Gift is exceptionally cold.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the keepsake on the tainted soil.
